description: Use this when you need the choices for a creation before pricing it: the models, durations, formats and modes for an image, a short video or a voice-over, and the pictures each model takes (max_reference_images, start_image, end_image). For voice-overs: the voices of one model, filtered by language and gender, a page at a time. Exact prices come from the quote_* tools.

model.description: Voice-over model whose voices to list. Default: the default model.

offset.description: Voice-overs: next_offset from the previous page.

voice_gender.description: Voice-overs: only voices of this gender.

voice_language.description: Voice-overs: only voices that speak this language (a code such as fr, en, es, pt), plus multilingual ones.

name: list_creation_options
title: List models and voices
